articles.title: Badshah shares emotional reel after ex-wife Isha Rikhi’s eviction from 'Bigg Boss 20', rapper says, ‘I’m not well, but I love you’
articles.summary: Rapper Badshah has shared an emotional Instagram reel thanking his fans for their love and support, shortly after his ex-wife, Punjabi actress Isha Rikhi,
articles.body: Rapper Badshah has shared an emotional Instagram reel thanking his fans for their love and support, shortly after his ex-wife, Punjabi actress Isha Rikhi, was evicted from the reality show house. In the video, the rapper can be heard speaking in a noticeably strained, low voice, explaining that he is unwell. The post has since gone viral, with fans expressing concern as well as support in the comments.Badshah thanks fans after Isha Rikhi’s exitTaking to Instagram shortly after Isha Rikhi’s eviction, Badshah shared a brief video message for his followers. Speaking in a strained voice, which he attributed to a bad throat, the rapper said, “Hello, kaise ho aap sab log? I just want to thank you for all the love, blessings, and the support. That’s it. Just taking this moment to show my gratitude to all of you.”Apologising for his voice, Badshah added, “I’m not well. But I love you.”The timing of the post comes shortly after Isha’s exit from the reality show, amid renewed public interest in the former couple following their separation earlier this year.Isha Rikhi largely stayed away from discussing BadshahDuring her stint on the show, Isha Rikhi largely refrained from discussing her relationship with Badshah or their brief marriage. Despite entering the house amid considerable curiosity about her personal life, the actress did not extensively discuss their past relationship or make the rapper a central part of her conversations.Her approach surprised some viewers, given the attention surrounding the former couple’s separation.Fans react to Badshah’s emotional videoBadshah’s reel quickly drew reactions from fans, with several users expressing concern over his health and sending him messages of support.One user commented, “Senty hogye bhai aaj,” while another wrote, “Aree bhai esa mat karo, main aap ko spot karuga.” A third comment read, “Bhai koi galat kadam mat uthana.”While some comments focused on supporting the rapper, others appeared concerned about the emotional tone of the video. Badshah himself did not explicitly link the reel to Isha’s eviction or comment on the reasons behind posting the message.Badshah had earlier shared and deleted a reaction to Isha’s evictionBefore sharing the reel, Badshah had posted an Instagram Story reacting to Salman Khan announcing Isha Rikhi’s eviction during the ‘Weekend Ka Vaar’ segment.In the now-deleted story, Badshah appeared to laugh as Salman joked about Isha’s confidence. The rapper subsequently removed the post from his Instagram account.A look at Badshah and Isha Rikhi’s relationshipBadshah and Isha Rikhi reportedly dated for nearly four years before getting married in March 2026. However, just five months after their wedding, the couple announced their separation in August.Both Badshah and Isha shared identical statements on Instagram Stories, confirming that they had mutually decided to part ways and move forward separately. They also requested fans and the media to respect their privacy.Their separation announcement came just months after their wedding and sparked considerable interest among fans, particularly because the couple had largely kept their relationship private.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Tallulah Willis shares rare glimpse of dad Bruce Willis in touching new photo
articles.summary: The sweet father-daughter moment comes weeks after Tallulah Willis' wedding.
articles.body:
Bruce Willis is sharing a sweet father-daughter moment with Tallulah Willis .

Tallulah Willis shared a rare new photo with her father on Instagram on Monday, showing her kissing the actor on the forehead while gently holding his head.

"So cute! 😚😚," the 32-year-old captioned the photo.

Tallulah is the youngest of Bruce Willis and Demi Moore's three daughters.

The touching photo comes weeks after Tallulah married Justin Acee on Aug. 8 at her family's home in Idaho, with her father by her side for the celebration.

Photos from the wedding showed Tallulah resting her head on her father's shoulder as he wrapped an arm around her, while Acee stood beside them holding Bruce Willis' hand.

Bruce Willis' family announced in March 2022 that he had been diagnosed with aphasia and would be stepping away from acting. In February 2023, his family announced that he had received a more specific diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia, or FTD.

Tallulah has previously opened up about cherishing and documenting her time with her father.

"I find that I'm trying to document, to build a record for the day when he isn't there to remind me of him and of us," she wrote in a 2023 essay for Vogue .

She has also shared other glimpses of their bond on social media.

In June 2025, Tallulah posted photos showing her holding her father's hand and embracing him during a family visit.

Earlier that month, she also shared a sweet photo of herself sitting on the floor and hugging Bruce Willis' legs as he sat on a couch.

articles.title: Curta Novo Atendimento: filme de Santos ganha 7 prêmios internacionais | G1
articles.standfirst: 'Novo Atendimento' acompanha a tentativa de um homem de pedir um simples café expresso e usa humor para abordar as dificuldades de serviços cotidianos na era da tecnologia.
articles.summary: O curta Novo Atendimento, de Tales Ordakji, usa o humor para criticar a tecnologia e representa o cinema de Santos no festival FESTin, em Portugal.
articles.body:
Curta-metragem de Santos (SP) participa do FESTin, em Lisboa, Portugal. — Foto: Divulgação

O curta-metragem 'Novo Atendimento', dirigido e estrelado pelo santista Tales Ordakji, foi selecionado para a competição oficial do 17º Festival de Cinema Itinerante da Língua Portuguesa (FESTin), em Lisboa, Portugal. A produção, que já conquistou sete prêmios em festivais no Brasil e no exterior, será exibida no evento realizado entre 1º e 11 de outubro.

Ambientado em Santos , no litoral de São Paulo, o filme de 12 minutos acompanha Lipe, personagem interpretado por Tales, durante uma tentativa de pedir um simples café expresso.

De acordo com a divulgação, o curta mistura comédia e crítica para abordar a dificuldade de realizar serviços do cotidiano na era da tecnologia. Além de Tales, o elenco conta com Cris Eifler e Cibele Gonçalves, que também assina a produção.

A participação no FESTin marca a estreia de “Novo Atendimento” em Portugal. Cibele e Tales viajam ao país a convite do festival, realizado entre 1º e 11 de outubro.

Para Tales, a seleção amplia a circulação internacional da obra e dá visibilidade ao audiovisual produzido na Baixada Santista.

O filme foi produzido pela Atado no Ato com recursos da Lei Paulo Gustavo, do Ministério da Cultura, por meio da Secretaria de Cultura de Santos, com apoio da prefeitura. A produção também teve suporte dos espaços culturais Casa UmMeiaZero, DesenheiTudo e Empreender na Cozinha.

Cibele Gonçalves e Tales Ordakji (à esq.); Cris Eifler e Tales Ordakji (à dir.). — Foto: Divulgação

Desde a estreia, o curta-metragem conquistou sete prêmios em cinco países e foi selecionado para mais de 20 festivais de cinema. Confira as conquistas:

No Brasil: Melhor Filme – Mostra Pega Leve, no Festival de Cinema de Caruaru (PE); Troféu Toninho Dantas, na 17ª Mostra MABS, do Movimento Audiovisual da Baixada Santista.

No exterior: Melhor Curta e Melhor Direção – Oklahoma Latin American Film Festival, nos Estados Unidos; Melhor Ator, para Tales Ordakji – COLIFFE (Coliseum International Film Festival), na Itália; Melhor Curta de Comédia – 9º Digital Griffix Film Awards, no Canadá; Menção Honrosa – London Worldwide Comedy Short, na Inglaterra.

O ator Tales Ordakji contou ao podcast Baixada em Pauta que a carreira começou após o incentivo de um professor em uma aula de artes. A partir dali, procurou cursos de teatro em Santos e seguiu na profissão. Na ocasião, ele afirmou que estava "vivendo um sonho".

articles.title: 'Pralay: Kalyani Priyadarshan shifts to Mumbai for Ranveer Singh starrer, undergoes intense action training, follows special diet ahead of Bollywood debut in Jai Mehta's zombie thriller
articles.summary: Kalyani Priyadarshan has reportedly moved to Mumbai to focus on Pralay, her first Hindi film, in which she stars opposite Ranveer Singh.
articles.body: Kalyani Priyadarshan has reportedly moved to Mumbai to focus on Pralay, her first Hindi film, in which she stars opposite Ranveer Singh. According to a recent report, the 'Lokah' actor has rented an apartment in Juhu and has been preparing extensively for Jai Mehta’s zombie thriller. Kalyani has undergone action training, followed a specialised diet and participated in readings and rehearsals with Ranveer. The film’s next schedule is expected to resume in October.Kalyani Priyadarshan shifts to Mumbai for Pralay prepAccording to a report by Mid-Day, Kalyani Priyadarshan has been based in Mumbai as she prepares for 'Pralay', her upcoming Hindi-language debut. The actor, who has largely been associated with Chennai and Kochi, has reportedly rented an apartment in Juhu to remain close to the film’s preparation and production requirements.A source cited by the publication said the arrangement has been made to allow Kalyani to stay focused on the project until filming is completed. The actor is expected to remain in Mumbai through the production of the film.Kalyani undergoes action training for Ranveer Singh starrer'Pralay' is reportedly demanding an extensive physical preparation from Kalyani. She began action training in May, ahead of the film going on floors in July, and has also been following a specially planned diet for the role.According to the afore mentioned publication, Kalyani and Ranveer have gone through multiple readings, workshops and rehearsals together. The two actors completed the first schedule before Ranveer took paternity leave. The production is expected to resume in October and continue through December.The physical preparation is particularly important for Kalyani's character, with the actor required to maintain a lean physique for the zombie thriller.Kalyani and Ranveer Singh’s 'Pralay' scheduleDirected by Jai Mehta, 'Pralay' is being mounted as a zombie thriller with Ranveer Singh and Kalyani Priyadarshan in the lead. The project marks Kalyani’s entry into Hindi cinema after establishing herself through work in the South Indian film industries.The film’s next schedule is expected to begin in October following Ranveer’s paternity break. The shoot is reportedly planned to continue until December, keeping Kalyani occupied in Mumbai for the coming months.Kalyani Priyadarshan also gave fans a glimpse into her Mumbai schedule through Instagram, revealing that she was “fully locked in to Pralay” this Onam. The actor said she missed celebrating the festival with her family, including the traditional Onam Sadhya and dressing up in a white saree, as work kept her away from home. Instead, she shared a photo dump featuring moments from the past few months and sent her followers warm wishes for the festival.Kalyani Priyadarshan explores more Hindi and South projectsHer Mumbai move is also allowing Kalyani to explore opportunities beyond Pralay. According to the report by the publication, the actor has been meeting filmmakers in the city as she looks to build a career across both Hindi and South Indian cinema.Kalyani Priyadarshan’s work slateOn the work front, Kalyani Priyadarshan was last seen in 'Odum Kuthira Chaadum Kuthira' starring Fahadh Faasil, Revathi Pillai, Dhyan Sreenivasan, Lal, Vinay Forrt and Suresh Krishna. She was also seen in Dulquer Salmaan backed 'Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra' alongside Naslen, Sandy, Chandu Salim Kumar and Arun Kurian.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Vimal Elaichi case: Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff RESPONDED to FDA notices, reveals Tukaram Mundhe- More details inside
articles.summary: Tukaram Mundhe, Commissioner of the Maharashtra FDA, has confirmed that Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff have each responded to the notices
articles.body: Tukaram Mundhe, Commissioner of the Maharashtra FDA, has confirmed that Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff have each responded to the notices issued over their Vimal Elaichi advertisement. Two of the actors sought a hearing, he revealed, and both have now taken place. The regulator says it will be pursuing the matter further.Tukaram Mundhe on hearings in Vimal Elaichi caseAccording to ANI, Tukaram Mundhe revealed, "Regarding those notices, responses from all three have come. Two of them had asked for a hearing. Their hearing was finished yesterday, and we are proceeding further."Maharashtra FDA's notices over Vimal Pan Masala adThe latest development comes weeks after the Maharashtra FDA served show-cause notices on the three actors for featuring in a pan masala advertisement. The regulator alleges the campaign is a case of surrogate advertising for Vimal Pan Masala, which is banned in the state. Shah Rukh, Ajay and Tiger were asked to clarify their roles as brand endorsers and explain why action shouldn't be taken against them. The authority also demanded endorsement-related records, such as contracts, campaign briefs, payment details and evidence of due diligence.FDA cites Food Safety and Standards Act against endorsersThe regulator relied on Section 24 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the provision covering misleading and deceptive food advertisements. It also cited Section 53, which allows a penalty of up to Rs 10 lakh for those involved in publishing such an advertisement. The FDA maintained that celebrity endorsers can't wash their hands of responsibility by pointing the finger at the manufacturer or advertiser.Tukaram Mundhe on due diligence for endorsersEarlier, Mundhe had noted that advertising norms place accountability on the individual or organisation endorsing a product, and that this includes a duty to carry out due diligence.Ajay Devgn, Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff's Vimal associationFor context, Ajay has been associated with Vimal's campaigns for several years now. Shah Rukh later joined the campaign, while Tiger came on board after Akshay Kumar stepped away from it. Akshay had drawn criticism in 2022 for his association with the brand, after which he apologised, announced that he was withdrawing from the endorsement and said he would donate his fee to a cause.Ajay Devgn and Shah Rukh Khan on celebrity endorsementsMeanwhile, Ajay had earlier defended his association with Vimal, clarifying that he was endorsing elaichi rather than pan masala. Shah Rukh, too, has commented on celebrity endorsements in the past, saying that if a product is considered harmful, its manufacture or sale should be stopped instead of holding actors solely responsible.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 55 [LIVE]: Vishal Chaturvedi and Shobhinaw Satyaa's spiritual biopic on Neem Kaorli Baba biopic maintains momentum, crosses Rs 313 India net mark
articles.summary: 'Hanuman Ansh' continues to hold steady at the box office as it enters Day 55, with its India net collection now at Rs. 312.38 crore at the end of Day 54.
articles.body: 'Hanuman Ansh' continues to hold steady at the box office as it enters Day 55, with its India net collection now at Rs. 312.38 crore at the end of Day 54. Vishal Chaturvedi's spiritual biopic on Neem Karoli Baba, led by Shobhinaw Satyaa, remains firmly on track to add further milestones even after crossing the Rs. 400 crore worldwide mark, with collections continuing to trickle in steadily nearly two months after release on August 7 in India and September 11 in the overseas markets.Having already weathered several ups and downs across its run, from a whisper-quiet start to sudden late bursts of momentum, the film continues to prove its staying power at the ticket window. With its India net collection already at Rs. 312.58 crore at the beginning of Day 55 live tracking, 'Hanuman Ansh' now has the Rs. 315 crore domestic mark within easy reach over the next couple of days. On the worldwide front, with the global gross already past Rs. 408 crore, the film looks set to inch towards the Rs. 410-415 crore range soon, continuing what has become one of the most durable theatrical runs of the year.'Hanuman Ansh's domestic box office run'Hanuman Ansh' had already crossed Rs. 300 crore in India net by the end of Day 52, following a dramatic climb from its modest Rs. 1.08 crore opening week through a series of blockbuster weeks that peaked at Rs. 90.25 crore in Week 5. After a brief cooling-off period on Day 53 with Rs. 2.35 crore, the film added a further Rs. 3.10 crore on Day 54 across 4,411 shows, taking its cumulative India net to Rs. 312.38 crore and gross collection to Rs. 369.00 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ overseas collection and worldwide totalInternational markets have continued to add modest but consistent sums through this stretch of the film's run. Having reached Rs. 38.75 crore in overseas gross by the end of Day 53, the film added another Rs. 0.25 crore on Day 54, taking its cumulative overseas total to Rs. 39 crore. Combined with its domestic numbers, this pushed the worldwide gross to Rs. 408 crore by the close of Day 54.'Hanuman Ansh' Day 55 collection live trackingAs per Sacnilk, 'Hanuman Ansh' is currently running across 2,930 shows on Day 55, having added Rs. 1.07 crore to the tally so far in the day.This takes the film's overall India gross to Rs. 370.17 crore and its India net to Rs. 313.35 crore, with the final Day 55 figure expected once all shows for the day have concluded.Day wise collections for 'Hanuman Ansh'Week 1: Rs. 1.08 croreWeek 2: Rs. 0.40 croreWeek 3: Rs. 10.40 croreWeek 4: Rs. 61.00 croreWeek 5: Rs. 90.25 croreWeek 6: Rs. 80.25 croreWeek 7: Rs. 44.80 croreDay 50: Rs. 3.35 croreDay 51: Rs. 6.50 croreDay 52: Rs. 9.00 croreDay 53: Rs. 2.35 croreDay 54: Rs. 3.10 croreDay 55 [LIVE]: Rs. 1.07 croreTOTAL: Rs. 313.35 croreMore about 'Hanuman Ansh'Written and directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, 'Hanuman Ansh' is a devotional biopic based on the early life and teachings of Neem Karoli Baba, also known as Maharaj Ji, tracing his spiritual journey while exploring faith, devotion, compassion and selfless service.Shobhinaw Satyaa plays Neem Karoli Baba, with Purnima Tiwari portraying his wife, Ram Dulari, alongside Chandan Anand as Dr Ram Nandan Bhosale, Anil Rastogi as Mahantji, Gulshan Pandey as Inspector Dharam Singh and Vihaan Shedge essaying Maharaj Ji in his younger years. The film is certified U by the CBFC and carries a runtime of approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes, with Vishal Chaturvedi, Ragini Sona, Anupriya Nagar and Namrata G Singh credited as producers.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Prahaar’ trailer launch: Maharashtra CM Fadnavis says film carries MESSAGE, praises Rajkummar Rao and Ujjwal Nikam
articles.summary: At the trailer launch of ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story Of Ujjwal Nikam’ on Tuesday, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis talked about the film's
articles.body: At the trailer launch of ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story Of Ujjwal Nikam’ on Tuesday, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis talked about the film's storyline and commended the team behind it. The trailer was unveiled at Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), a station that was among the places targeted in the 26/11 terror attacks.Devendra Fadnavis thanks makers for 26/11 storyFadnavis initiated by thanking the makers for choosing to tell a story built around the 26/11 attacks and the legal fight that followed. He also had words of appreciation for Rajkummar Rao, who plays veteran public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam, and said Prahaar isn't just meant to entertain but also carries a message.Speaking about how Ajmal Kasab was dealt with after the 26/11 attacks, Fadnavis remarked, "Perhaps if we wanted, we could have killed Kasab. We could have shot him. But our police and our judicial system very thoughtfully showed the world that India is a state where, at least, we can take action against terrorists." He then lauded Advocate Ujjwal Nikam for his part in the Kasab trial, adding, "And I would especially like to thank Ujjwal Nikam ji because he did not just work to ensure that a terrorist was sentenced to death; he also exposed the design behind it, the conspiracy behind it, before the world."Devendra Fadnavis alleges Pakistan's role in 26/11Fadnavis went on to allege that Pakistan was behind the 26/11 attacks, describing them as "state-sponsored terrorism". He gave Nikam credit for exposing what he called the conspiracy behind the attacks to the world. The Maharashtra CM also touched on how Pakistan is viewed in the context of terrorism, calling it a country that "supports terrorism". He added that he had been able to look into the matter closely, and again commended Nikam for the way he handled the case.Lauding Nikam's way of working, Fadnavis said, "Jis professionalism ke saath, jis shiddat ke saath, jis deshbhakti ke saath Ujjwal Nikam ji ne is poore case ko steer kiya..." In his view, Nikam's efforts drew attention to the sacrifice of the police personnel killed during the attacks. Fadnavis recalled officers such as former Mumbai Anti-Terrorism Squad chief Hemant Karkare, Additional Commissioner of Police Ashok Kamte, senior police inspector Vijay Salaskar and Assistant Sub-Inspector Tukaram Omble, among others, and said justice wouldn't have been served in the same manner without them on the ground.Devendra Fadnavis praises Rajkummar Rao and 'Prahaar' teamThe CM also appreciated the film's cast and crew, especially Rajkummar Rao, stating, "Main Prahaar ka bahut-bahut aabhari hoon... Aur Rajkummar Rao jaise accomplished actor, aur poori team itni accomplished hai." He further said, "Toh main yeh keh sakta hoon ki yeh mere entertainment nahi, ismein ek sandesh hai." The remarks suggested he regards the film as more than just entertainment, one that carries a message.Devendra Fadnavis compares 'Prahaar' with 'Chhaava'Citing ‘Chhaava’ as an example, Fadnavis said cinema can make significant episodes of history, and the lives of those who shaped them, accessible to many more people. In his words, ‘Chhaava’ told the story of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, the son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, while Prahaar brings Ujjwal Nikam's story and the 26/11 case to viewers in a similar way. He concluded with an appeal to watch Prahaar and added that he intends to catch the film himself.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘The Paradise’ box office collection day 7 [Live]: Nani and Srikanth Odela’s film continues decent pace amid mixed response; crosses Rs 150 crore worldwide gross
articles.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela’s action thriller ‘The Paradise’ is on its way to complete its first week on the big screens.
articles.body: Nani and Srikanth Odela’s action thriller ‘The Paradise’ is on its way to complete its first week on the big screens. The film opened to a strong response at the box office and minted more than Rs 75 crore worldwide, including special screenings. However, despite a strong headstart, the film received a mixed response from audiences and its box office collections have declined since the opening weekend.As the film is set to complete its first week, the film’s next challenge is to maintain its theatrical run and attract audiences over the coming days. Although the viewers praised the film’s scale and cinematography, it drew criticism for weak writing, pacing issues, underdeveloped characters and technical inconsistencies.‘The Paradise’ day 7 live collectionsAccording to a report by Sacnilk, ‘The Paradise’ has collected over Rs. 62 lakh over 1,455 shows so far on Wednesday.As per today’s live collection the film’s total India net collections stands at Rs. 102.12 crore and the total India gross collections to Rs. 120.73 crore.‘The Paradise’ has been released in multiple languages. The live figures of the Telugu version suggest that it made Rs 52 lakh with 709 shows and Rs 10 lakh with 746 shows in Hindi version as of now.‘The Paradise’ day 6 overseas numbersSpeaking of the collections overseas, on Tuesday the film made Rs 50 lakh, which brings the total overseas gross collections to Rs 30.50 crore. This brings the worldwide gross collection to Rs 150.50 crore.Currently, the film’s total occupancy stands 11.9%.Looking at the box office collection so far, ‘The Paradise’ marked Nani and Srikanth Odela’s biggest opening making Rs 76.90 crore worldwide including its special screenings a day ahead of official release.Day wise collectionDay 0 (special screening): Rs. 11.60 croreDay 1: Rs. 34.65 croreDay 2: Rs. 14.90 croreDay 3: Rs. 15.25 croreDay 4: Rs. 15.70 croreDay 5: Rs. 5 croreDay 6: Rs. 4.40 croreDay 7: Rs. 62 lakhTOTAL: Rs. 102.12 croreNani and Srikanth Odela reunited after the success of their 2023 film ‘Dasara’.About ‘The Paradise’‘The Paradise’ is set in the slums of 1980s Secunderabad, the film follows a marginalized community facing social discrimination and being denied basic rights. 'The Paradise' is a period action drama directed by Srikanth Odela, with Nani playing Jadal, a man from the marginalised Savari community who is drawn into a violent struggle against an oppressive feudal power structure. The film also stars Kayadu Lohar as Subbalakshmi, Mohan Babu as Shikanja Maalik, Raghav Juyal as Vikram Malik and Sonali Kulkarni as Samakka, with Keerthy Suresh appearing in a cameo.The film received an ‘A’ certificate from the CBFC, with reports noting modifications to violent sequences, dialogue and subtitles during the certification process. The certification was issued ahead of its September 24, 2026 theatrical release.Set in 1980s India, The Paradise centres on the Savari community, whose members face marginalisation, lack of rights and exploitation under a powerful feudal system. Jadal, who grows up amid these conditions, gradually becomes a central figure in the community’s resistance, leading to a violent confrontation with Shikanja Maalik and his regime.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. articles.title: 'Koffee With Karan' one last time: Karan Johar bids emotional farewell to his talk show, here's when and where you can watch the last season
articles.summary: ‘Koffee With Karan’ is set to bid an emotional farewell to its audience.
articles.body: ‘Koffee With Karan’ is set to bid an emotional farewell to its audience. After more than two decades of celebrity confessions, controversial revelations, rapid-fire answers and memorable conversations, Karan Johar is returning with the ninth and final season of the popular chat show.The makers have now released a special glimpse of the upcoming season, featuring Karan reflecting on the show's long journey and revealing why he feels it is finally time to say goodbye.‘Koffee With Karan’ first premiered in 2004 and has since become one of the most talked-about celebrity chat shows on Indian television and streaming. Over the years, the couch has witnessed friendships, romances, fallouts, candid confessions and several moments that went on to dominate headlines.Speaking about the final season, Karan Johar, Host and Creator of Koffee With Karan, said, "There are some journeys you don't plan to end, you simply know, somewhere deep within you, when it is time to let them go. Koffee With Karan has been an extraordinary part of my life. It has given me friendships, memories, moments of complete madness, a lot of love and, yes, its fair share of controversy!""But through all of it, what has remained constant is the audience. They have laughed with us, debated us, trolled us, celebrated us and, most importantly, kept coming back for another cup. Saying goodbye is emotional, but it also feels right. This final season is my way of raising the mug one last time with gratitude, with love and with everyone who has made Koffee With Karan what it is. So, come have one last cup of Koffee with me. One last time," he added.In the emotional video, Karan looks back at how the show came into existence and recalls discussing his idea of hosting a celebrity chat show with his late father in June 2004. He says, "It was June 2004 when I told my dad that I really wanted to host a talk show. I wanted to host two celebrities or stars and have an informal, candid chat with them. He told me, 'Karan, you are going to call your friends, talk to them, something that you do every day anyway. Who will pay you for that?'"Karan further recalled, "He passed away that same month, actually. On 26 June. The very first day I shot for it was 16 August 2004. And I'm here now, eight seasons later, 22 years later, 161 episodes later. A lot happened. I called lovers. I called friends. I called families. I called lovers who went on to become ex-lovers. Some of them even got married. I put an end to the careers of national icons. I am living with the term 'nepo' even today. Conjecture became a national word. So much happened."Looking back at the show's enduring popularity, he said, "Everywhere I go, fortunately or unfortunately, they always ask me, 'When is the next season of Koffee With Karan?' I wonder why they never ask me, 'When is my next feature film?' But whatever it was, it gave me so much. I reached a point in my life where I realised all good things must come to an end. This will be my very last season of Koffee With Karan."Meanwhile, speculation around the celebrity line-up for Season 9 has already been doing the rounds. Names such as Ahaan Panday and Aneet Padda, along with Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, have been linked to the upcoming season. However, the makers have kept the guest list under wraps so far. The official line-up will be revealed when ‘Koffee With Karan’ Season 9 premieres on October 14.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Ranvir Shorey hit Pooja Bhatt, so I broke his rib, car's glass,' says Rahul Bhatt as he regrets doing so: 'He was very decent, I did a wrong thing'
articles.summary: Ranvir Shorey and Pooja Bhatt's relationship and subsequent fallout have remained a subject of discussion for years.
articles.body: Ranvir Shorey and Pooja Bhatt's relationship and subsequent fallout have remained a subject of discussion for years. Now, Pooja's younger brother Rahul Bhatt has revisited an incident involving Ranvir Shorey from nearly two decades ago, revealing that he once assaulted the actor while stepping in during an altercation between Ranvir and Pooja. Rahul also admitted that he regrets taking matters into his own hands and praised Ranvir for the way he eventually handled the situation.Rahul recalled the incident and said in an interview with Siddharth Kannan, "There was an altercation between Ranvir Shorey and Pooja Bhatt. They had an argument, after which Ranvir hit her or something like that. I had to step in and, when I did, my response was a bit exaggerated. I broke his car's glass. I broke one of his ribs. I did a wrong thing by taking the law into my own hands. Subsequently, I paid the price for it. I was arrested. Charged."Rahul went on to admit that he regretted his actions. He said, "I regret it. I shouldn't have overreacted. Back in those days, I said I would do it again. But in the case of Ranvir Shorey, I shouldn't have. He was very decent. During the compounding of the offence, he came forward and said, 'Let bygones be bygones.'"Praising Ranvir for not holding on to the incident, Rahul added, "Nobody does something like that. People usually use such situations to extract money, but he didn't. He came and compounded the case, and the FIR was quashed. Until then, I had a criminal case pending. He was very decent in that. I respect him for that. Nobody else would have done it without holding a grudge," concluded Rahul Bhatt.The revelation comes amid renewed discussion around Ranvir's tumultuous relationship with Pooja and the allegations that followed their breakup. Ranvir and Pooja, who were friends before entering a relationship, had a highly publicised split in the early 2000s. Pooja had previously alleged that Ranvir was physically and verbally abusive, particularly when he was under the influence of alcohol. Ranvir has denied the allegations.The actor had also spoken about the fallout with the Bhatt family during his stint on Bigg Boss OTT 3, where he emerged as the second runner-up. Recalling that phase of his life, Ranvir had said, “During the same time, I also encountered the biggest scandal of my life with another actress. As I was unable to cope, my brother asked me to come to the US with him for a while. I pursued a six-month acting course in the US and borrowed money from my brother. After returning from the US, I started shooting for The Great Indian Comedy Show in 2005. At that time, two of my long-shelved films were greenlit for release and hit theatres back-to-back within a week, and my work was loved by audiences. After those films, I finally felt my life was steady as an actor and that I had arrived.”Ranvir later discussed the dispute in an interview with Siddharth Kannan, claiming that he felt his equation with Mahesh Bhatt had been used against him. He said, "At the time we had a conflict, I felt that the respect I had for him, he used that manipulatively. When the fight happened, he told my father, 'OK, we will rest the matter here, whatever the fight happened between the kids.' The next day, he proceeded to print utter lies about me and planted false stories in the media against me, painting me as an alcoholic, abusive person. All lies."When asked whether the dispute was only between him and Pooja, Ranvir said, "Her brother was the one who assaulted me. He (Mahesh Bhatt) could have told these guys not to talk like that. In that sense, I felt he was manipulative towards me. These are all 25-year-old stories. I don't want to get into them now."Ranvir and Pooja dated in the early 2000s and lived together before their relationship ended in a much-publicised breakup around 2002. Ranvir later married actress Konkona Sen Sharma. The couple welcomed their son Haroon in 2011 and separated in 2015. Pooja, meanwhile, married Manish Makhija in 2003, though the two later parted ways.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: When the human face becomes a language of memory and identity
articles.summary: What can a face reveal beyond the person it belongs to?
articles.body: What can a face reveal beyond the person it belongs to? That question formed the starting point of HEADS – Every Face Holds a Story, a group exhibition that brought together diverse interpretations of the human face at Shridharani Gallery, Triveni Kala Sangam, New Delhi.Curated by gallerist Amrita Kochhar, the exhibition, which concluded on September 23, brought together works by artists including Anjolie Ela Menon, Arpana Caur, Jatin Das, Jogen Chowdhury, K Laxma Goud, Krishen Khanna, Rameshwar Broota, Sakti Burman, Shipra Bhattacharya, Thota Vaikuntam and Vasundhara Broota, among others.Rather than treating the face simply as a subject for portraiture, the exhibition approached it as a visual language — a space where identity, emotion, memory, thought and experience could take different forms.The works moved across styles and generations. While some artists engaged with recognisable faces and portraiture, others used abstraction, distortion, symbolism and imagination to explore what lies beneath or beyond physical appearance. The resulting collection offered contrasting ways of looking at a subject that is at once universally familiar and deeply personal.Several works created specifically for the exhibition were also presented alongside selected works by established artists, bringing together newer interpretations with artistic practices developed over decades.“The head is perhaps one of the most powerful subjects in art. It carries identity, thought, emotion, memory and experience,” said Kochhar. “With HEADS, we wanted to bring together artists who see this subject in profoundly different ways. Every face holds a story, and every artist reveals a different chapter.”The exhibition also carried a personal significance for Kochhar, being held in memory of her late mother, Dr Manjit Kochhar. A doctor who was associated with medicine, charity and seva, she was remembered through the showcase as an individual whose values extended beyond her profession.By bringing together established masters, senior practitioners and contemporary voices, HEADS turned a familiar artistic subject into a conversation about how faces can hold fragments of personal history, cultural memory and imagination.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Roy K John turns the garden into a landscape of memory
articles.summary: What we see when we first look at a garden can be shaped as much by memory as by what lies before our eyes.
articles.body: What we see when we first look at a garden can be shaped as much by memory as by what lies before our eyes. This idea formed the core of Kerala-based artist Roy K John’s recent works, showcased in his solo exhibition Kani: Garden as First Sight at Bikaner House, New Delhi.Curated by Satyajit Dave, the exhibition, which concluded on September 10, brought together John’s recent paintings and 3D wooden works, exploring the garden as a space of memory, perception and transformation.The title draws from the Kerala tradition of ‘Kani’, the auspicious first sight of beauty, abundance and hope traditionally associated with dawn. John uses this idea to move beyond the conventional landscape, creating gardens that feel less like static views of nature and more like visual thresholds.Drawing on his training in traditional Kerala mural painting, the artist builds orchards, groves and botanical forms through layered compositions, rhythmic lines and saturated colours. Vegetation takes on an architectural quality in his works, with tree trunks resembling columns and leaves functioning almost like screens that reveal and conceal fragments of domestic life and memory.The garden, therefore, becomes more than a backdrop. It becomes a space through which the artist explores how people remember places, objects and experiences, and how familiar natural forms can change when viewed through personal memory.The exhibition also featured John’s recent wooden leaf sculptures, extending his engagement with botanical forms into three dimensions. Their tactile quality brought another dimension to his exploration of nature, while also drawing attention to the abundance and fragility of the natural world.“In Roy K John’s garden, the first sight is never simply what is before the eyes. It is what the eye learns to notice,” reads the curatorial note accompanying the exhibition.John’s practice draws on his formal training in traditional mural painting at the Temple of Arts, Guruvayoor, as well as his education at the Kalabhavan School of Arts, Thrissur. His recent works translate elements of Kerala’s classical mural vocabulary into contemporary explorations of landscape and botanical forms.Through Kani, the artist offered a different way of looking at the garden , not simply as a depiction of nature, but as a meeting point between what is seen, what is remembered and what is imagined.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Nani seeks Goddess Kanaka Durga’s blessings in Vijayawada as 'The Paradise' nears Rs 150 crore gross in India
articles.summary: Natural Star Nani after the release of his latest film 'The Paradise' visited the Kanaka Durga Temple at Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada and offered prayers
articles.body: Natural Star Nani after the release of his latest film 'The Paradise' visited the Kanaka Durga Temple at Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada and offered prayers to Sri Durga Malleswara Swamy and Goddess Kanaka Durga. Temple officials and staff welcomed Nani, who had a special darshan before receiving blessings from the pandits. He was also presented with sacred offerings and prasadam. Videos and pictures from the visit have now caught the attention of his fans.Nani seeks Goddess Kanaka Durga’s blessings amid 'The Paradise' responseNani’s temple visit comes at a time when 'The Paradise' is receiving a mixed response from audiences. The Srikanth Odela directorial has become one of the major talking points among Telugu cinema fans, with Nani’s performance and the film’s intense world drawing considerable attention. After the film’s release, the actor also spoke about the unusual response surrounding the project and thanked audiences for making the film their own. His latest visit to the temple can be seen as a moment of gratitude following the theatrical release.'The Paradise' box office adds to Nani’s latest success story'The Paradise' has also been making its presence felt at the box office. The Paradise opened with strong numbers and continued to attract audiences during its opening days. Nani plays the lead in the Srikanth Odela-directed film, which features Kayadu Lohar, Mohan Babu and Priyadarshi in important roles. Anirudh Ravichander composed the music, while Sudhakar Cherukuri backed the film. The response to the movie has also kept discussions around Nani’s performance and Srikanth Odela’s filmmaking active across social media.Nani’s spiritual side comes into focus after 'The Paradise' releaseDuring his Vijayawada visit, Nani completed the special darshan and received the blessings from the temple priests. Fans who learned of his presence gathered at the temple hoping to catch a glimpse of the actor, with several also posing for pictures. The visit follows another spiritual outing by Nani and the core team, who visited the Medaram temple and performed the traditional Tulabharam ritual by offering jaggery equivalent to Nani’s body weight. As 'The Paradise' nears Rs 150 crore gross in India, Nani’s latest temple visit has given fans another memorable moment away from the big screen.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
